newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidek hit by lawsuit and poor results.
newsitem.headline: Sidek hit by lawsuit and poor results.

text.p: Holding company stock Sidek and sister companies steelmaker Simec and tourist arm Situr were all down sharply in late trade on the Mexican bourse on Tuesday, after suffering a double blow of poor earnings reports and a lawsuit, traders said.
"Sidek was hoping to postpone obligations until after it produces a debt restructuring plan, but their being ordered to pay up in a New York court comes as a heavy blow," a trader said.
A U.S. District Court in New York ruled against Sidek on Monday, and in favor of three hedge funds that had sued the company.

"A ruling was made against Sidek as garantor, in favor of certain holders of Class "B" notes issued by the Third Mexican Acceptance Corp., who had sued Sidek for $20 million in damages," Sidek had said on Monday.
Also on Monday, Sidek had posted a nine-month net loss, as opposed to a net gain in 1995.
